DHAKA, Dec 25, 2022 (BSS) - Prime Minister and Awami League President Sheikh Hasina today urged the leaders and activists to give utmost priority to strengthening the party, saying that Awami League's biggest strength is the confidence and trust of the mass people.

"You (leaders and activists) must strengthen the party giving the highest priority to it. This is my request to you," she said.
